turns.question: What share of non-cancelled order revenue between 17 August and 2 October 2026 came from orders that have no return at all, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: revenue cannot be split by whether an order has a return, since no dimension on revenue_eur marks orders with or without a return, so I cannot give this percentage. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (non-cancelled order revenue), net_revenue_eur (revenue minus partner returns), returns_eur, return_rate (share of orders returned) and repeat_revenue_share, but none gives the share of revenue from orders with no return.
